title: Multiple Choice - Conversation Completion
description: Choose the correct response to complete the conversation.

questions.text:
Tom: 'What kind of TV show should we watch tonight?'
Mary: '______________________________'
options: I want to cook some hot soup for dinner.
We should walk to the sports club today.
Please wash your green school shirt now.
Let's watch that new comedy to relax.
questions.correct_answer: Let's watch that new comedy to relax.

questions.text:
Peter: 'Why do you love that space cartoon?'
Linda: '______________________________'
options: Because our father buys a big brown table now.
Because my brother walks to the city library.
Because the maths homework is very hard for me.
Because the space robot character is so funny.
questions.correct_answer: Because the space robot character is so funny.

questions.text:
Kevin: 'That young violinist plays so well on stage!'
Anna: '______________________________'
options: Yes, she is a wonderful performer.
Yes, the kitchen floor is very clean now.
No, we must buy a new football today.
No, our school begins at seven on Monday.
questions.correct_answer: Yes, she is a wonderful performer.

questions.text:
David: 'When does the science documentary start?'
Sarah: '______________________________'
options: Buy two train tickets at the railway station.
Close the bedroom window because of the rain.
Wash your dirty sports shoes after the match.
Check the TV guide on the school website.
questions.correct_answer: Check the TV guide on the school website.

questions.text:
Jack: 'Would you like to watch this animated film?'
Emma: '______________________________'
options: No, the bus arrives at the station now.
No, I do not like eating sweet apples.
Yes, I would love to watch it.
Yes, my sister has three white rabbits.
questions.correct_answer: Yes, I would love to watch it.

questions.text:
Mark: 'What do you think of this English channel?'
Lucy: '______________________________'
options: It has four large wooden chairs in the room.
It is raining heavily outside on the street.
It has many educational programmes for kids.
It costs too much money to buy a computer.
questions.correct_answer: It has many educational programmes for kids.

questions.text:
Mai: 'Why did you stop that video clip?'
Nick: '______________________________'
options: Because our dog is sleeping under the table.
Because it is so boring and nothing happens.
Because the hot tea is very sweet and tasty.
Because my friends are swimming in the lake.
questions.correct_answer: Because it is so boring and nothing happens.

questions.text:
Alex: 'Shall we watch the Olympic swimming race together?'
Ben: '______________________________'
options: Yes, because I really love watching swimming competitions.
No, because the library is very quiet today.
Yes, because our bus goes to school at eight.
No, because my new bicycle has bright wheels.
questions.correct_answer: Yes, because I really love watching swimming competitions.

questions.text:
Lan: 'Does your brother like that weekend game show?'
Tom: '______________________________'
options: Yes, he answers every question very quickly.
No, the weather is very cold in the morning.
Yes, my little brother can ride his bicycle.
No, we should buy fresh bread for breakfast.
questions.correct_answer: Yes, he answers every question very quickly.

questions.text:
Sam: 'Is this rocket launch a live broadcast?'
Kelly: '______________________________'
options: Yes, my mother makes delicious apple pies.
Yes, the spaceship is lifting off right now.
No, the train leaves the station at ten a.m.
No, we must borrow some storybooks at school.
questions.correct_answer: Yes, the spaceship is lifting off right now.
